_description: Pre-Notion filter rules. Applied BEFORE creating Notion pages. Jobs matching these rules go straight to Archive in TSV, never reach Notion.

company_cap.note: Count active applications per company within a rolling window (BL-136). Default 30 days — older rows age out so dormant companies become live again. Statuses counted: To Apply, Applied, Interview, Offer, Rejected, Closed; Inbox and Archived do NOT count.

company_blocklist._description: Companies where ALL roles are a weak fit for this candidate. Auto-archive.

title_blocklist._description: Title patterns that auto-archive regardless of company. Matched case-insensitively as substrings.

role_targets._description: RFC 030 — single source of truth for acceptable role-tracks. Read by scan (title gate) and by LLM prepare (Fit Score). One block changes BOTH gates. RFC 033 (BL-78) — at least one track is required on every profile; replace the example below with your real role-tracks.

fit_treatments.primary: Apply Fit Score by domain match only. Track is the candidate's main target.
fit_treatments.bridge: Bridge/stepping-stone role. Apply standard domain logic but never downgrade purely for being on this track instead of the primary one.

location_rules._description: Restrict to specific locations / remote-only. Empty = no location filter.

hard_blockers._description: RFC 039 / BL-89 — deterministic pre-SKILL filter. Rows that match any rule here NEVER reach Claude and are archived in TSV with `skip_reason=hard_blocker:<code>`. Keep the list short — these are STRUCTURAL disqualifiers (a skill the candidate does not have, a years cap, a cert the candidate lacks). For soft fit (PM vs SWE, fintech vs healthcare), let the SKILL judge.

requirement_blockers._description: RFC 046 / BL-B — operator-owned regex escape hatch that runs AFTER hard_blockers. Each pattern is a JS regex source plus a kebab-case `reason` label; a match removes the row pre-SKILL with `skip_reason=requirement_blocker:<reason>`. `flags` defaults to 'i'. `match_in` defaults to ['requirements', 'full_text_excerpt'] — allowed values: 'requirements', 'responsibilities', 'full_text_excerpt'. Reason label must match /^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,40}$/. Invalid regex/reason entries are dropped at load with a stderr warning; the count surfaces on prepare_context.stats.requirement_blocker_pattern_errors.
